paragraphs: The E-Pace D165 uses the Ingenium AJ200D — a 2.0-litre four-cylinder diesel that's part of Jaguar Land Rover's modular Ingenium engine family. It's fitted across the entire X540 generation, which has been on sale since 2017. The AJ200D is the same diesel engine family used across the XE, XF and F-Pace ranges, which is why the known timing chain pattern is consistent across these models. The D165 sits as the entry-level diesel in the E-Pace line-up, with the D200 offering a higher-power version of the same 2.0-litre diesel unit.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace AJ200D engines for every E-Pace D165 on the road.

cards.body: A 2.0-litre four-cylinder diesel fitted to the E-Pace D165 from 2017 to present (X540 generation). Known for timing chain wear over time — see the callout above.
